ActivationView.description: Local execution state, independent of the GitHub App state.

added_by.description: Original requester's GitHub identity, absent for legacy direct installs.

admitted.description: Initial admission completed and will survive a later downgrade.

ask_admin.description: Ask an existing Admin when this person cannot manage the required action.

can_enable.description: Current Admin can approve when no billing blocker remains.

preparing.description: Server is retrying remote preparation after authorization completed.

reasons.description: Both reasons can exist at the same time.

oneOf.description: Product action for a billing hold.

BoatAccountView.description: Safe connected-account metadata with no key or key ciphertext.

connected_at.description: The time this key version connected.

name.description: The account name returned by Boat during verification.

rejected_at.description: The first time Boat refused this key, absent while the key is accepted.

BoatConnection.description: Key verification and a required monthly limit for every Boat connection.

api_key.description: The customer's own Boat key, used only for this request.

spend_limit_cents.description: Positive integer US cents as a decimal string.

wallet.description: Boat wallet identity. Personal is the default when no organization is selected.

BoatSpendView.description: Rounded display amounts. Exact decimal costs still govern Boat admission.

bounded.description: Whether all current-month costs have either a known value or a safe bound.

confirmed_cents.description: Provider-confirmed costs, rounded once after aggregation to integer US cents.

limit_reached.description: Whether exact counted costs have reached the saved monthly limit.

settled_bound_cents.description: The settled-bound portion of unconfirmed costs, rounded after aggregation.

unconfirmed_cents.description:
Unconfirmed costs, including pending bounds and expired settled bounds.
Rounded once after both parts are added. This is not a provider-confirmed charge.

CacheView.description: Machine-cache metadata. Clear cache acts only on this machine's entries.

capacity_bytes.description: Machine-cache capacity bytes, as a decimal string.

docker_disk_bytes.description: Persistent Docker disk bytes, which Clear cache preserves.

hits_last_7_days.description: Local hits during the last seven days.

restores_last_7_days.description: Handled restores during the last seven days.

used_bytes.description: Machine-cache bytes used, as a decimal string.

Cents.description: Integer US cents encoded as a string to preserve JavaScript precision.

CommandResult.description: Result of immediate gateway command delivery.

connected.description: Whether the active local agent connection accepted the command.

DiskView.description: Last reported disk capacity and free space.

capacity_bytes.description: Total bytes as a decimal string.

free_bytes.description: Free bytes as a decimal string.

EligibleWorkspace.description: An offered destination backed by fresh own-user membership proof.

requires_upgrade.description: Selecting it currently creates a billing hold.

InstallCommand.description: Install command returned to an Admin only.

command.description: Single shell command containing the one-hour install secret.

id.description: Record identity used for early revocation.

requirements.description: Machine requirements displayed next to the command.

InstallLink.description: Top-level navigation to GitHub's unchanged organization chooser.

attempt_id.description: Random attempt identity, not workspace selection authority.

url.description: Configured installation URL carrying only opaque state.

InstallationState.description: Current GitHub App state shown by setup and Settings.

LabelFit.description: Computed machine capacity for a label preview.

fitting_machines.description: Count of those machines that fit at least one job.

maximum_jobs.description: Maximum whole jobs per fitting machine, absent when none fits.

minimum_jobs.description: Minimum whole jobs per fitting machine, absent when none fits.

no_machine_fits.description: Whether no allowed own machine currently fits this size.

unavailable_machines.description: Machines whose prepared capacity or required root allocation is unavailable.

LabelInput.description: Label definition whose name never changes after creation.

allow_boat.description: Whether Boat may run this label.

allow_machines.description: Whether own machines may run this label.

disk_gb.description: Free job disk in decimal GB, apart from the full image disk.

when_nothing_fits.description: What happens when neither destination fits.

LabelView.description: A stored label with its current machine fit.

fit.description: Capacity range for connected machines that accept jobs.

LinkState.description: Observable progress of one installed organization association.

MachineCostInput.description: Current monthly cost entered independently from the warm-runner target.

monthly_cost_cents.description:
Integer US cents. Known zero remains distinct from an unknown cost.
The interval starts at entry time and supplies no earlier historical price.

MachineView.description: Hardware and state for one own machine. Byte counts use decimal strings.

capacity_known.description: Whether prepared capacity and the required root allocation are available.

concurrent_default_jobs.description: Whole default-label jobs that fit concurrently, including disk.

health_old.description: Whether health values describe old contact data.

hostname.description: Host name reported by the agent.

kvm.description: Whether KVM can start job VMs.

oneOf.description: Current monthly machine cost in integer US cents.

offline.description: Whether no contact arrived during the last sixty seconds.

selected_image_disk_bytes.description: Full root disk of this machine's selected image, absent when unknown.

slots.description: Reported CPU and memory slot capacity.

MemberView.description: One workspace member or access request.

id.description: Stable GitHub account identifier as a string.

login.description: Account name, absent before its first dashboard sign-in.

requested_at.description: Initial request or grant time in UTC.

oneOf.description: Granted role, absent for an open request.

MembersView.description: Current roles and pending requests for the Settings Members tab.

admin_notice.description: Trust notice used before an Admin grant.

members.description: People with roles or unanswered access requests.

open_requests.description: Count displayed on the Members tab.

NothingFits.description: Waiting policy for a label that currently fits nothing.

OrganizationLinkView.description: Complete typed picker/recovery result for the original requester.

oneOf.description: Linked local state, absent before registration.

reauthorization_required.description: Reading metadata does not authorize use of a stored GitHub grant.

reauthorization_url.description: Fresh authorization action for this original person.

workspaces.description: Current eligible choices, with no default selection.

OrganizationTier.description: Tier needed to admit several linked organizations.

OrganizationUpgrade.description: Exact workspace and minimum tier for a supported billing action.

tier.description: Minimum tier that supports several organizations.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose confirmed plan must change.

OrganizationView.description: One GitHub organization registration and its own repository policy.

activation.description: Local admission, independent of GitHub's App state.

delete_after.description: Owner-removal retention deadline, absent for an intentional take-out.

github_id.description: Stable GitHub organization identity as a string.

installation_id.description: Current installation identity as a string.

manage_url.description: GitHub URL for installation visibility changes.

state.description: Active, suspended, or removed App state.

OverflowPolicy.description: Complete routing policy editable in Settings under Overflow.

enabled.description: Whether the workspace permits new Boat runners.

spend_limit_cents.description: Positive monthly integer US cents as a decimal string.

wait_seconds.description: The supported overflow waits are 0, 15, 30, 60, and 120 seconds.

OverflowSettings.description: Boat Setup and Settings data shared by their connection form.

oneOf.description: Safe account metadata, absent after skip or disconnect.

available.description: Whether the deployment has a shared Boat image and the Boat service.

enabled.description: The switch that permits new Boat starts.

next_month_at.description: First instant of the next calendar month in UTC.

oneOf.description: Current-month cost display, absent when provider observations are unavailable.
Saved limit for the connection or reconnect form.

wait_seconds.description: The saved overflow wait in seconds.

PendingInstallation.description: An organization installation request that an owner has not approved.

github_id.description: Organization identity as a decimal string.

id.description: Stable GitHub request identity as a decimal string.

Problem.description: Stable error body returned by every dashboard route.

message.description: Safe explanation with no credentials or provider response body.

ProblemCode.description: Closed set of machine-readable dashboard failures.

RemovedOrganization.description: Organization removal metadata verified through this person's GitHub membership.

delete_after.description: Exclusive deadline for a reinstall that preserves retained history.

github_id.description: Stable GitHub organization identity as a decimal string.

login.description: Organization name shown on the removed-App page.

oneOf.description: Allow every visible private repository, including future ones.
Allow only the supplied stable GitHub repository identities.

RepositorySelection.description: Private repository policy, independent for each organization.

RepositoryView.description: One installation-visible repository. Public repositories cannot get a runner.

allowed.description: Whether this private repository currently has access.

full_name.description: Owner and repository name returned by GitHub.

id.description: Stable GitHub repository identity as a string.

private.description: Whether the repository is private and can be selected.

RoleChange.description: A role grant or change. The Admin trust notice precedes this request.

SessionView.description: The fixed-duration dashboard sign-in and accessible workspaces.

csrf_token.description: CSRF token for requests that change data.

install_url.description: Install entry point when no workspace is available.

organization_links.description: Current requester-owned installation recovery and workspace choices.

pending_install_requests.description: Requests owned by this exact GitHub person, awaiting an organization owner.

reauthorization_required.description: Whether a newly available role/request needs fresh GitHub membership proof.

reauthorization_url.description: Same-origin top-level navigation for fresh GitHub authorization.

oneOf.description: Most recent owner removal among the memberships verified at authorization.
Verified setup return, recorded only after fresh user association proof.

state.description: Signed-in access state for install, access, and left pages.

workspaces.description: Workspaces whose organizations contain this person.

can_add_organization.description: Whether the current tier permits another organization.

labels.description: Active labels and their computed machine fit.

name.description: Workspace name editable by an Admin.

open_requests.description: Count displayed on the Members tab.

organizations.description: Current organizations, including owner-removed records during retention.

SetupJob.description: First-job progress for the last non-Boat Setup step.

assigned_at.description: GitHub scale-set assignment time, absent when GitHub supplied none.

phase.description: Current UUID demand phase supplied by GitHub.

oneOf.description: Execution destination, absent until a runner is assigned.

workflow_ref.description: Workflow file identity, without treating it as a checked job ref.

oneOf.description: The original person's request still waits for owner approval.
An organization installation visible to its current organization member.

suspended.description: Whether GitHub has suspended the installation.

oneOf.description: Personal installation requires an organization, without a workspace.

remove_url.description: GitHub settings link that removes this installation.

SetupOutcome.description: Token-free setup outcome proved by configured-App and fresh user APIs.

SetupPhase.description: GitHub scale-set demand phases, without invented queue or Actions identities.

SetupPlace.description: Actual runner placement known from the matching durable runner record.

SetupView.description: Non-Boat setup progress for one workspace.

current_image_disk_bytes.description: Current release image disk metadata, separate from machine-selected images.

oneOf.description: The first observed job, absent while no job has entered this workspace.

organizations.description: Installed organizations and their current App states.

waiting_for_machine.description: Whether the page still waits for its first machine.

SignInState.description: Sign-in remains valid when no private workspace session can be retained.

SlotState.description: The closed set of slot occupancy states.

SlotView.description: Last reported occupancy of one slot.

index.description: Zero-based slot index as a decimal string.

job_id.description: Job identity, present only for a running job.

runner_id.description: Registered runner identity, absent for a free slot.

Success.description: Empty success payload for idempotent mutations.

warm_runners.description: Desired warm runner count. It does not change monthly cost.

WorkspaceChoice.description: Explicit selection of a previously offered workspace.

WorkspaceRole.description: Stable workspace role on the HTTP boundary.

WorkspaceView.description: Workspace access, recovery, and soft-limit state.

admins.description: Admin names shown to members who request access.

can_claim_admin.description: Whether an owner claim can recover the Admin role.

organization_limit_exceeded.description: Whether this workspace exceeds Free's organization soft limit.

oneOf.description: This person's role, absent while access is pending.
